Mean RR describes only intervals between observed peaks.

fields.value: Slow irregular ventricular rhythm, about 50 bpm by the conditional short-strip count and about 47 bpm by mean RR, with a longer final interval and recurring P-like lobes. A sinus-origin rhythm with rate variation is a teaching possibility only if sinus-compatible P morphology in a known lead and the atrial-to-ventricular sequence are confirmed throughout, including the longer gap. PR constancy is unestablished. The later broad waves are not extra counted QRS complexes; the longer ventricular interval alone does not establish sinus pause, arrest or AV block.
fields.basis: New independently reviewed educational synthesis of the exact original raster, conditional source measurements and stated course criteria; not a source-authored or educator-validated rhythm answer
fields.reason: Qualified ECG educator review has not occurred. Visible-deflection observations are supplied without validated P-wave identity. PR and QRS have unvalidated conditional estimates. Optional educational comparison only, not a source-authored answer or confirmed rhythm diagnosis. A candidate atrial association is not proof of sinus origin. Timing retains the recorded calibration assumptions and holds. Interval envelopes apply to the selected endpoint-review cycles and describe boundary uncertainty, not actual beat-to-beat variability, normal conduction or a full-strip atrial census. These newly derived observations remain unscored and are not eligible as validated answer keys.

limitations: Wave observations and conditional endpoint envelopes remain provisional and unscored. QT/QTc, calibrated amplitudes and clinical diagnosis are not established. Selected-complex widths do not establish sequence certainty.

P-wave text is a provisional description, not validated atrial identity. PR has an unvalidated conditional endpoint envelope for selected complexes. QRS has an unvalidated conditional endpoint envelope for selected complexes. Validated electrical boundaries and qualified educator adjudication remain outstanding.
Calibration assumes the course’s 25 mm/s convention, not speed metadata printed on each strip. Peak uncertainty is approximately ±2 source pixels, excluding errors in identifying the waveform.
